form.label: Park Planner
form.description: Your best day starts with a better first ride.

search.query: `queue_times_index` sourcetype=queue_times:ride | stats latest(park_name) as park_name by park_id | sort park_name
`queue_times_index` sourcetype=queue_times:ride park_id=$park|s$ | stats latest(ride_name) as ride_name latest(park_name) as park_name by ride_id | eval label=park_name." / ".ride_name | sort label

div.p: Your best day starts with a better first ride.
Choose a park and weekday, then Apply. Start with the readiness check. Rank rides by the wait you might avoid, compare their early availability, and choose a backup. All hours are local to the park.
Three-day recommendations are the default. “1 day” is exploratory. Observed hours can include early entry; confirm your access and official hours.

search.query: `queue_times_index` sourcetype=queue_times:ride park_id=$park|s$ | where isnotnull(park_local_date) | eval weekday=strftime(strptime(park_local_date,"%Y-%m-%d"),"%w") | search weekday=$weekday|s$ | search ride_id=$ride|s$ | stats dc(park_local_date) as Days

`queue_times_index` sourcetype=queue_times:ride park_id=$park|s$ | where isnotnull(park_local_date) | eval weekday=strftime(strptime(park_local_date,"%Y-%m-%d"),"%w") | search weekday=$weekday|s$ | `queue_times_observed_day` | search ride_id=$ride|s$ | where open=1 AND _time>=first_open AND _time<=last_open | stats count as Samples

search.query: `queue_times_index` sourcetype=queue_times:ride park_id=$park|s$ | where isnotnull(park_local_date) | eval weekday=strftime(strptime(park_local_date,"%Y-%m-%d"),"%w") | search weekday=$weekday|s$ | `queue_times_observed_day` | search ride_id=$ride|s$ | where complete_day=1 AND _time<=last_open | eval period=case(_time>=first_open AND _time<first_open+1800,"First30",_time>=first_open+1800 AND _time<first_open+3600,"Next30",_time>=first_open+3600,"Later") | where isnotnull(period) | stats median(eval(if(period="First30" AND open=1,wait_time,null()))) as First30_median perc95(eval(if(period="First30" AND open=1,wait_time,null()))) as First30_P95 median(eval(if(period="Next30" AND open=1,wait_time,null()))) as Next30_median median(eval(if(period="Later" AND open=1,wait_time,null()))) as Later_median avg(eval(if(period="First30",100*open,null()))) as Early_open_pct count(eval(period="First30" AND open=1)) as Early_samples count(eval(period="Later" AND open=1)) as Later_samples dc(eval(if(period="First30" AND open=1,park_local_date,null()))) as Early_days dc(eval(if(period="Later" AND open=1,park_local_date,null()))) as Later_days by park_name ride_name | where Early_days>=tonumber($days|s$) AND Later_days>=tonumber($days|s$) AND Early_samples>=6 AND Later_samples>=12 | eval Potential_wait_avoided=round(Later_median-First30_median,1), Cost_of_delaying_30m=round(Next30_median-First30_median,1),Early_open_pct=round(Early_open_pct,1) | where Potential_wait_avoided>0 | sort 0 - Potential_wait_avoided - Cost_of_delaying_30m First30_median | table park_name ride_name First30_median First30_P95 Next30_median Later_median Potential_wait_avoided Cost_of_delaying_30m Early_open_pct Early_days Later_days | appendpipe [ stats count | where count=0 | eval Status="No qualifying observations for these filters yet. Check Opening data readiness, widen the learning window, or select 1 day for exploratory results." | fields Status ] | rename First30_median AS "First 30m · median" First30_P95 AS "First 30m · P95" Next30_median AS "Next 30m · median" Later_median AS "Later · median" Potential_wait_avoided AS "Potential minutes avoided" Cost_of_delaying_30m AS "Cost of delaying 30m" Early_open_pct AS "Early open %" Early_days AS "Early days" Later_days AS "Later days" park_name AS "Park" ride_name AS "Ride" wait_time AS "Wait · minutes"

div.strong: A timing advantage is not an itinerary.
div.p: Walking time, height requirements, reservations, paid-access inventory and official schedules are not included. P95 describes longer posted waits in the sample—not a promise. Use the live board before committing to a queue.

div.span: Posted waits. Observed patterns. Your decisions.
